# sigma_source_swap_policy (Resource)

A Sigma source swap policy. Defines rules for swapping connection paths, enabling environment promotion and multi-tenant content deployment. `type` is immutable after creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Source swap policy that maps paths from a dev connection to a prod connection.
#
# `type` is immutable after creation — changing it forces replacement.
# `swaps_json` is an opaque JSON object whose structure depends on `type`.
# For type "connection", use {"connectionSwaps": [...]}.
resource "sigma_source_swap_policy" "dev_to_prod" {
  type               = "connection"
  name               = "Dev → Prod Swap"
  from_connection_id = "<dev-connection-id>"

  swaps_json = jsonencode({
    connectionSwaps = [
      {
        toConnectionId = "<prod-connection-id>"
        path0          = { value = "ANALYTICS" }
        path1          = { value = "PUBLIC" }
      }
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_swaps` (Attributes List) Per-connection swap rules. Each entry maps a target connection ID and resolves three path components (`path0`, `path1`, `path2`) — typically database, schema, table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_swaps))
- `from_connection_id` (String) ID of the source connection whose paths will be swapped.
- `name` (String) Display name of the policy.
- `type` (String) Policy type. Currently only `"connection"` is supported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_swaps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_swaps`

Required:

- `path0` (Attributes) Resolution rule for the first path component (typically the database). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_swaps--path0))
- `to_connection_id` (String) Target connection ID — paths matching this swap rule are rewritten to point at this connection.

Optional:

- `path1` (Attributes) Resolution rule for the second path component (typically the schema). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_swaps--path1))
- `path2` (Attributes) Resolution rule for the third path component (typically the table). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_swaps--path2))

<a id="nestedatt--connection_swaps--path0"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_swaps.path0`

Required:

- `swap_type` (String) Resolution strategy for this path component. One of `exact` (literal — set `catalog_object`), `attribute` (resolve via `user_attribute_id`), or `all` (pass through; no other fields).

Optional:

- `catalog_object` (String) Literal catalog name. Required when `swap_type = "exact"`.
- `user_attribute_id` (String) User attribute ID whose value supplies the path. Required when `swap_type = "attribute"`.


<a id="nestedatt--connection_swaps--path1"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_swaps.path1`

Required:

- `swap_type` (String) Resolution strategy for this path component. One of `exact` (literal — set `catalog_object`), `attribute` (resolve via `user_attribute_id`), or `all` (pass through; no other fields).

Optional:

- `catalog_object` (String) Literal catalog name. Required when `swap_type = "exact"`.
- `user_attribute_id` (String) User attribute ID whose value supplies the path. Required when `swap_type = "attribute"`.


<a id="nestedatt--connection_swaps--path2"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_swaps.path2`

Required:

- `swap_type` (String) Resolution strategy for this path component. One of `exact` (literal — set `catalog_object`), `attribute` (resolve via `user_attribute_id`), or `all` (pass through; no other fields).

Optional:

- `catalog_object` (String) Literal catalog name. Required when `swap_type = "exact"`.
- `user_attribute_id` (String) User attribute ID whose value supplies the path. Required when `swap_type = "attribute"`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_source_swap_policy.example '<source_swap_policy_id>'
```
